abstract: Assesses benthic turbidity controls, marine mammal acoustic monitoring compliance, and ecological impact mitigation
system_message:
You are the Environmental and benthic protection officer (ECO), responsible for evaluating benthic turbidity controls, marine mammal acoustic monitoring compliance, and ecological impact mitigation across candidate cable repair consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic mitigation profiling（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ECO-NOISE-XDN：North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership records a hydrophone detection sensitivity of 195 dB based on the underwater acoustic calibration for cetacean avoidance.
ECO-NOISE-G33：Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium maintains a hydrophone detection sensitivity of 185 dB across its passive acoustic monitoring array for cetacean avoidance sound pressure reception.
ECO-NOISE-GYE：Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance demonstrates a hydrophone detection sensitivity of 205 dB for its passive acoustic monitoring array calibrated reception threshold.

information_points.title: Assesses benthic turbidity controls, marine mammal acoustic monitoring compliance, and ecological impact mitigation（BENTHIC）
information_points.content:
ECO-BENTHIC-1D4：For North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership, the seabed repair execution methodology does not achieve environmental impact mitigation compliance regarding marine mammal observation protocols and turbid plume containment limits.
ECO-BENTHIC-WKN：For Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium, the seabed repair execution methodology demonstrates environmental impact mitigation compliance, adhering to marine mammal observation protocols and turbid plume containment limits.
ECO-BENTHIC-YG6：For Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance, environmental impact mitigation compliance is confirmed under the seabed repair execution methodology, satisfying marine mammal observation protocols and turbid plume containment limits.
